# Tiktok (20 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /profile | `handle` / `user_id` | 1 | Get TikTok user profile |
| /profile/videos | `handle` | 1 | List TikTok user videos |
| /post | `url` | 1 | Get TikTok post details |
| /post/comments | `url` | 1 | List TikTok post comments |
| /video/comment/replies | `comment_id`, `url` | 1 | List TikTok comment replies |
| /comment | `comment_url` / `author_username` / `text_contains` | **2** | Look up one TikTok comment by URL or id |
| /search | `query` | 1 | Search TikTok videos by keyword |
| /trending | `region` | 5 | Get TikTok trending feed |
| /search/hashtag | `hashtag` | 1 | Search TikTok by hashtag |
| /search/top | `query` | 1 | TikTok top search results |
| /search/users | `query` | 1 | Search TikTok users |
| /user/audience | `handle` | 5 | Get TikTok user audience demographics |
| /user/followers | `handle` / `user_id` | 1 | List TikTok user followers |
| /user/following | `handle` | 1 | List TikTok user following |
| /user/live | `handle` | 1 | Get TikTok user live stream |
| /post/transcript | `url` | 10 | Get TikTok video transcript — ⛔ **BANNED in this plugin: 10 credits, no advantage. Transcribe with the local captions→Groq→Whisper chain instead.** |
| /song | `clipId` | 1 | Get TikTok song details |
| /song/videos | *(none)* | 1 | List TikTok videos using a song |
| /profile/region | `handle` | 1 | Get TikTok profile region |
| /profile/full | *(none)* | **5** | TikTok profile, recent posts, and computed analytics in one call. |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `handle` *(optional, string)*: TikTok username without the @ symbol.
- `user_id` *(optional, string)*: TikTok numeric user ID. Use this for faster responses.
- `handle (/profile/videos)`: TikTok username without the @ symbol
- `user_id (/profile/videos)` *(optional, string)*: TikTok user id. Use this for faster responses.
- `sort_by` *(optional, enum: latest | popular)*: What to sort by
- `max_cursor` *(optional, string)*: Cursor to get more videos. Get 'max_cursor' from previous response.
- `region` *(optional, string)*: Region (Country) you want the proxy in. Defaults to US.
- `trim` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response
- `url`: Full URL of the TikTok video
- `region (/post)` *(optional, string)*: Region of the proxy. Sometimes you'll need to specify the region if you're not getting a response. Commonly for videos from the Phillipines, in which case you'd use 'PH'. Use 2 letter country codes like US, GB, FR, etc
- `trim (/post)` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to get a trimmed response
- `download_media` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to also download the video/images and get back permanent, durable media URLs under `data.post.ext.download_media_urls` (`[{ post_id, cdn_url, type, cached }]`). Use these for archiving — the raw `media_urls` are short-lived signed CDN links that expire. Adds a few seconds of latency while the media is fetched.
- `url (/post/comments)`: Full URL of the TikTok video to fetch comments for
- `cursor` *(optional, integer)*: Cursor to get more comments. Get 'cursor' from previous response.
- `trim (/post/comments)` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to get a trimmed response
- `comment_id`: TikTok comment ID. This is the cid from the comments endpoint.
- `url (/video/comment/replies)`: TikTok video URL. This is the url from the comments endpoint.
- `cursor (/video/comment/replies)` *(optional, integer)*: Cursor to get more replies. Get 'cursor' from previous response.
- `comment_url` *(optional, string)*: A TikTok comment URL: `https://www.tiktok.com/@{handle}/video/{videoId}?comment_id={cid}`, the `m.tiktok.com/v/{id}.html?...&share_comment_id={cid}` share form, or a `vm.tiktok.com/{code}` / `tiktok.com/t/{code}` shortlink. Mutually exclusive with `post_url`+`comment_id`.
- `post_url` *(optional, string)*: The post URL (`https://www.tiktok.com/@{handle}/video/{videoId}`). Combine with `comment_id`, or with `author_username`/`text_contains` for a search.
- `comment_id (/comment)` *(optional, string)*: The target comment's numeric id (the `cid` from the comments endpoint). Requires `post_url`.
- `parent_comment_id` *(optional, string)*: The parent comment's numeric id — supply this when the target is a reply so it can be resolved directly via the native replies endpoint.
- `author_username` *(optional, string)*: Return up to `max` comments authored by this username (no comment id needed). Mutually exclusive with `text_contains` and any comment id.
- `text_contains` *(optional, string)*: Return up to `max` comments whose text contains this snippet (case-insensitive). Mutually exclusive with `author_username` and any comment id.
- `deep_scan` *(optional, boolean)*: Widen the scan budget for deeply-buried comments (raises the page ceiling and deadline). Bills 6 credits instead of 2.
- `position_hint` *(optional, string)*: Opaque token from a prior lookup's `lookup.position_hint`. Passing it back probes the comment's last-known location first, making a re-check of an already-found comment cheap.
- `max` *(optional, integer)*: For `author_username`/`text_contains` search: max matches to return (1–20, default 5).
- `query`: Search keyword or phrase to find TikTok videos
- `date_posted` *(optional, enum: yesterday | this-week | this-month | last-3-months | last-6-months | all-time)*: Time Frame
- `sort_by (/search)` *(optional, enum: relevance | most-liked | date-posted)*: Sort by
- `region (/search)` *(optional, string)*: Note, this doesn't filter the tiktoks only in a specfic region, it puts the proxy there. Use it in case you want to scrape posts only available for some country. Use 2 letter country codes like US, GB, FR, etc
- `cursor (/search)` *(optional, integer)*: Cursor to get more videos. Get 'cursor' from previous response.
- `trim (/search)` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to get a trimmed response
- `region (/trending)`: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, KR)
- `trim (/trending)` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to get a trimmed response.
- `hashtag`: Hashtag to search for without the # symbol
- `region (/search/hashtag)` *(optional, string)*: Region the proxy will be set to. Note: this isn't going to grab you all tiktoks from this region, you're just setting the proxy there.
- `cursor (/search/hashtag)` *(optional, integer)*: Cursor to get more videos. Get 'cursor' from previous response.
- `trim (/search/hashtag)` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to get a trimmed response
- `query (/search/top)`: Search keyword or phrase
- `publish_time` *(optional, enum: yesterday | this-week | this-month | last-3-months | last-6-months | all-time)*: Time Frame TikTok was posted
- `sort_by (/search/top)` *(optional, enum: relevance | most-liked | date-posted)*: Sort by
- `region (/search/top)` *(optional, string)*: Note, this doesn't filter the tiktoks only in a specfic region, it puts the proxy there. Use it in case you want to scrape posts only available for some country. Use 2 letter country codes like US, GB, FR, etc
- `cursor (/search/top)` *(optional, integer)*: Cursor to get more videos. Get 'cursor' from previous response.
- `query (/search/users)`: Search keyword or phrase to find TikTok users
- `cursor (/search/users)` *(optional, integer)*: Cursor to get more users. Get 'cursor' from previous response.
- `trim (/search/users)` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to get a trimmed response
- `handle (/user/audience)`: TikTok username without the @ symbol
- `handle (/user/followers)` *(optional, string)*: TikTok username without the @ symbol
- `user_id (/user/followers)` *(optional, string)*: User id. Use this for faster response times.
- `min_time` *(optional, integer)*: Used to paginate. Get 'min_time' from previous response.
- `trim (/user/followers)` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to get a trimmed response
- `handle (/user/following)`: TikTok username without the @ symbol
- `trim (/user/following)` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true to get a trimmed response
- `handle (/user/live)`: TikTok username without the @ symbol
- `language` *(optional, string)*: Language of the transcript. 2 letter language code, ie 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'ja', 'ko', 'zh'
- `use_ai_as_fallback` *(optional, string)*: Set to 'true' to use AI as a fallback to get the transcript if the transcript is not found. Costs 10 credits to use this feature. And only if the video is under 2 minutes.
- `clipId`: TikTok sound/song clip ID
- `cursor (/song/videos)` *(optional, integer)*: The cursor to get the next page of results.
- `handle (/profile/region)`: TikTok username without the @ symbol
- `posts` *(optional, integer)*: How many recent posts to fetch + average the computed metrics over (1–100, default 25).
- `cursor (/profile/full)` *(optional, string)*: Pass a prior response's posts_cursor to deepen the post window.
- `include` *(optional, string)*: CSV subset of posts,computed (default both). include=computed drops the raw posts[] to save payload.

## Field Maps


The `profile` endpoint returns an `Author` response normalized by the `tiktok-author` field map, and `post` returns a `Post` normalized by `tiktok-post`. Both include computed fields (`engagement_rate`, `language`, `content_category`, `estimated_reach`) under `data.computed`. Use `?format=raw` to bypass both and get the upstream JSON. Other TikTok endpoints are passthrough.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/profile?" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
